subject: FinLytics POC: success criteria, evaluation plan & weekly status
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T15:10:00Z
Subject: FinLytics POC: success criteria, evaluation plan & weekly status

Thanks again for your time earlier, Raj — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kick-off: 

Summary of what we heard
- Goal: validate latency/cost for customer-facing summarization pipeline (~75 tokens/input, 10 req/s peak) and ensure output quality meets production thresholds.
- Success criteria (proposal):
  - Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms per request under 10 req/s sustained
  - Quality: ROUGE-L >= 0.6 vs. your baseline on the 200-sample evaluation set
  - Cost: target model/unit economics under $0.015 per 1k tokens (post-batching/quantization)

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): finalize success criteria, grant access (sample dataset + service account + SSO), schedule infra onboarding call.
- Week 1: Redwood provision trial environment, ingest sample set, run baseline run + initial tuning.
- Week 2: Run full evaluation set, collect metrics, and review tradeoffs (latency vs cost).
- Week 3: Joint review and recommendations for production rollout.

Ownership
- Redwood: Marissa (POC lead) for enablement + Marcus (solutions) for infra & tuning.
- FinLytics: Raj (POC sponsor) + FinLytics Ops (service account + data access).

Immediate asks (can we action these by EOD Wednesday?):
1) Share the 200-sample evaluation set (or a link) and service account details.
2) Confirm SSO requirements and any IP allowlisting needed.
3) Confirm the person who will accept invite for the onboarding call (30–45m).

Attached: FinLytics-POC-Plan-v1.pdf (light plan + evaluation checklist).

I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for onboarding once I have the access details. Looking forward — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: those targets look sensible. On quality, can we add a subjective acceptability threshold (e.g., 85% of samples marked as "acceptable" by product reviewers) in addition to ROUGE? We want to capture production tolerances.
- Access: Ops will provision a read-only S3 bucket with the 200 samples and a service account key. We will also need guidance on anonymization for a couple of fields — I can flag those in the dataset.
- SSO: We use Okta; we typically require SAML metadata + a test user for the trial. Ops will provide contact details.

Action items from my side:
1) Ops will send the S3 link and service account by EOW Tuesday (2026-06-16).
2) I’ll accept the onboarding invite once scheduled; looking for a 30–45m window on Thursday or Friday next week.

One more ask: Could you share the SOC 2 & data retention summary (even a short blurb) so I can include with our security review?

--
